question: Can one official-format checkpoint combine the absolute-life and phase teachers without choosing a model using another device's answer?
hypothesis: Allocate half the original hidden slots to each teacher's source-derived borders, then select the teacher-target mixing weight by leave-one-training-device-out minute RMSE. Shared features may retain the absolute teacher's long-life discrimination and the phase teacher's short-life calibration.
source: Official B training only. Each teacher uses eight uniformly spaced source rows per device, CatBoost 100 trees, depth 6, seed 17, thread_count 1. Phase target is remaining/total life; scale is median total life of the training devices in that fold. In every source-validation fold both teachers, border selection and output ridge exclude that device. The unchanged official initialization has previously seen all official training devices: source CV selects this adaptation and is not independent validation of the full system.

candidates.hidden: half absolute-teacher borders, half phase-teacher borders; width unchanged
candidates.fit_rows: all training rows, equal mass per physical training device
candidates.selection: lowest pooled squared error over all nine source held-device folds; ties in listed order

evaluation: Freeze source-selected weights before reading official validation or already-seen XJTU fifth-device scores. Report original 122-row service stream, full 1679-row official validation (same aggregate as six role permutations with each row twice), and existing 55 fifth-device measurements separately. Compare exact same rows with current and fixed median, absolute-hidden and phase controls. No new independent-device claim. Actually issue the source-selected checkpoint through life-checkpoint and verify every delivered prediction.
decision: Only advance an integrated candidate if source-selected weights improve current public service and full official validation RMSE and compare competitively to the strongest fixed controls. The actual delivered score determines the public-path result. A gain only on development data remains experimental until a frozen independent check. If this fails, end this combination; do not tune mixing weights using the service scores.
budget: One CPU study: 20 teacher fits including two final fits, 27 fold readout solves, 3 final readout solves, then at most one real checkpoint delivery and one integrity rerun if needed. No external service or platform. 3 additional recorded jobs, each <=300 seconds.
